title: Digger Drive Control
statement:
Draw the component diagram, and the data passed between the components.

This is a **pen-and-paper exercise**. Nothing is compiled, run, randomised or marked.

## The scenario

A digger has a **drive joystick** and a **seat that can rotate** (north / south).

The joystick is **fixed to the armrest of the seat**, so it turns with the operator.

Drive direction and gear selection depend on the state of these inputs.

## Your task

- Draw the **component diagram**.
- Label each link with the **data passed** between the components.

## How to use it

- Open **Guides > Question for this exercise**. It has a 20 minute timer.
- Answer on paper.
- When the timer ends, open **Guides > Worked solution** and compare.

## If time remains

- Where does the direction logic live, and why there?
- What happens when the seat is moving, or the sensors disagree?
- What happens to a joystick that is held while the seat rotates?
- What must the design do when a message is lost or corrupt?
